quotes.text: Adapt your beta advanced payment scenarios to the general release.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Your _PaymentIntent_ (API object that represents your intent to collect payment from a customer, tracking charge attempts and payment state changes throughout the process) must include a request for incremental authorization before confirmation.
The response now returns the status of the incremental authorization request in the `payment_method_details.card.incremental_authorization.status` property
attempting to capture the full remaining amount with the `final_capture` parameter set to `false` returns a 400 error.

findings: New raw lines 5-16 establish only the beta-to-general-release subject and four variant routes: incremental authorization, overcapture, extended authorization, and multicapture. The old raw lines 8-549 include all four variant bodies. The November index does not itself renew, deprecate, or alter the May 2026 API behavior.
Current source lines 4-7 and 67-69 list only the 2026-05-11 full raw; add the new 2026-11-07 navigation-only capture as distinct provenance while retaining the dated detailed source.

Old raw lines 22-150 require a preconfirmation PaymentIntent card request_incremental_authorization='if_available' rather than former optional request_incremental_authorization_support=true; latest_charge.payment_method_details.card.incremental_authorization.status reports available/unavailable after confirmation. The increment endpoint is unchanged. Current source lines 17-24 preserve the parameter delta but omit latest_charge nesting.

Old raw lines 153-229 add a mandatory preconfirmation request_overcapture='if_available', show latest_charge overcapture.status and maximum_amount_capturable, and allow capture amount_to_capture up to that reported maximum; the capture endpoint is unchanged. Current source lines 26-33 mostly preserve this dated behavior, but its status and maximum need the latest_charge and availability context.

Old raw lines 231-310 add preconfirmation request_extended_authorization='if_available', describe capture_before availability and capture before the deadline. Its prose at line 264 says extended_authorization.status values available/unavailable, while the adjacent JSON at lines 280-284 says enabled/disabled. Current source lines 35-42 chooses enabled/disabled; preserve the same-page contradiction rather than silently resolving it from the November index.

Old raw lines 312-489 require request_multicapture='if_available' before confirmation and show a dated 2026-04-22.preview; multicapture_migrate_to_ga_from_beta version/header transition. Multiple partial captures require the PaymentIntent to remain requires_capture; GA rejects final_capture=false when capturing the full REMAINING amount, and the old beta example succeeded. Current source line 49 says 'full amount', which is materially less precise than old raw line 416 and the 700-then-300 example at lines 388-475; correct to full remaining capturable amount.

Old raw lines 478-489 distinguish non-final charge.updated from final charge.captured and say no refund is created to represent uncaptured funds when final_capture=true in GA; current source lines 50-52 retain the point. Do not imply absence of all refunds or payment success from a request/response example.

Old raw lines 491-549 offer combined overcapture and incremental authorization only if BOTH feature statuses are available after confirmation; use maximum_amount_capturable as the threshold, else increment authorization then capture. Current source lines 54-58 omit the both-available condition, which could make the strategy appear unconditional.

Existing concept routes in wiki/concepts/stripe-incremental-authorization.md lines 26-48, stripe-overcapture.md lines 41-60, stripe-extended-authorization.md lines 35-43, and stripe-multicapture.md lines 19-45 cover separate general feature behavior. They do not route back to this migration source, but this review does not authorize concept edits; a dated reciprocal migration route would be useful if the coordinator later updates concepts.
historical_claims_to_preserve: 2026-05-11 old raw lines 22-150: incremental request field rename, former optional step becoming mandatory, latest_charge status available/unavailable, unchanged increment endpoint.
2026-05-11 old raw lines 153-229: new mandatory overcapture request, conditional available/unavailable status and maximum_amount_capturable, unchanged capture endpoint.

2026-05-11 old raw lines 231-310: new mandatory extended authorization request, capture_before deadline and unchanged capture endpoint; prose and example disagree on extended_authorization.status enum.

2026-05-11 old raw lines 312-475: dated multicapture transition header/version sample, request_multicapture, requires_capture partial state, and GA HTTP 400 for final_capture=false on full remaining amount.
2026-05-11 old raw lines 478-489: non-final charge.updated versus final charge.captured and no refund representation of uncaptured funds for final_capture=true.
2026-05-11 old raw lines 491-549: combined overcapture/increment strategy is conditioned on both features available and the reported overcapture maximum.
conflicts: Current source line 49 says 'full amount', while old raw line 416 and examples lines 388-475 specify full remaining amount after a prior partial capture; narrow the current wording.
Current source lines 56-58 omit the old raw line 546 both-features-available condition; put it before recommending overcapture or incremental authorization.

Old raw line 264 says extended_authorization.status available/unavailable, but adjacent JSON old raw lines 280-284 says enabled/disabled and current source line 40 follows that JSON. Record a reciprocal dated warning; new raw lines 9-16 cannot adjudicate.
unresolved_questions: The linked November variant bodies are not pinned (new raw lines 11-16); their current request contracts, version header transition and exact response enums remain unverified.

findings: Record the November variant index separately from dated May 2026 four-path behavioral evidence (new raw lines 9-16; source lines 4-7,67-69).
Correct multicapture source line 49 to 'full remaining amount' under final_capture=false and requires_capture state (old raw lines 376-416,453-475).
Condition combined overcapture/increment advice on both available statuses after confirmation and latest_charge details (old raw lines 491-549; source lines 54-58).

Qualify extended_authorization.status conflicting prose available/unavailable and JSON enabled/disabled (old raw lines 264,280-284; source line 40), and preserve version/header transition as dated (old raw lines 320-350; source line 48).
conflicts: Source line 49 'full amount' versus old raw line 416 'full remaining amount'.
Source lines 56-58 unconditional strategy versus old raw line 546 'if both features are available'.
Old raw line 264 prose status values versus old raw lines 280-284 JSON values and source line 40.
source_assessments.reason: The semantic new capture is navigation-only, but the current summary needs new provenance and material baseline corrections to multicapture conditions, combined-feature availability, and the old guide's internal enum conflict.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/flexible-features-migration, new raw lines 5-16 establish the migration subject and four variant links but contain no operational request or capture instructions. The dated old raw lines 22-150,153-229,231-310 and 312-489 document preconfirmation PaymentIntent requests for incremental authorization, overcapture, extended authorization and multicapture, latest_charge availability/status, manual capture states, the multicapture transition header, and changed webhook/refund behavior. source-stripe-flexible-features-migration.md broadly maps the four migrations but needs the full-remaining-amount condition and a qualification on combining features. Requesting a feature or confirming a PaymentIntent does not prove availability, capture or payment success.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/flexible-features-migration, new raw lines 9-16 are presentation and route navigation only; no substantive November API delta can be inferred against old raw lines 22-549. source-stripe-flexible-features-migration.md should retain the May 2026 beta-to-GA parameter, response, webhook, refund and version-header changes as dated history, and add the November index as separate provenance. Its multicapture error applies when final_capture=false tries to capture the full remaining amount, not any full original amount; the combination strategy requires both features available after confirmation. Old raw line 264 says extended status available/unavailable whereas old raw lines 280-284 show enabled/disabled; neither the uncaptured linked variants nor a test-card example settles that conflict or current account eligibility.
